chunks: And among his sayings (peace be upon him): 'Abdullah ibn Zama'ah, who was from his followers, came to him during his caliphate seeking money from him, so he (peace be upon him) said:

key_terms.عبد الله بن زمعة: Abdullah ibn Zama'ah, a companion of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) say when Abdullah ibn Zama'ah asked for money from the treasury?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha details 'Abdullah ibn Zama'ah's request for funds from the Bayt al-Mal during Imam Ali's caliphate, illustrating the practical application of fiscal justice and the Imam's direct engagement with his supporters. It serves as a key example of how Imam Ali managed state resources with transparency and fairness, distinguishing his rule from his predecessors. The incident underscores the Shia emphasis on the Imam's role as both a spiritual guide and a just administrator responsible for the welfare of the community.
